method: FOREX F5 horizon-matched forced all-pair blind. Every pair gets BUY/SELL. F4 revealed that 6h direction retained signal while 12h/24h did not. F5 therefore separates CONTINUATION, TACTICAL_6H and EXHAUSTION regimes; currency profiles only change impulse-vs-regime weighting, with no extra indicators. H1/H4 remain regime context, M15/6h strength drives tactical direction. Structural SL and dynamic TP are sized for an 8h trade horizon. LIMIT only tests a 2h pullback; same frozen SL/TP. No historical macro/news reconstruction.
